step-chop.text: Chop the scallion. Thin green rings, about 2–3 mm wide.

step-batter.text: Egg, water & flour. Three things into one bowl, one at a time.

step-season.text: Salt & pepper. A few twists of the grinder over the bowl.

step-whisk.text: Whisk until smooth. About thirty seconds of steady whisking.

step-scallions.text: Fold in the scallion. Green rings into the batter, a quick stir.

step-pan.text: Heat, oil & pour. A gentle heat and a thin film of oil.

step-first-side.text: Cook, then flip. Wait for set edges, then turn it over.

step-second-side.text: Finish & plate. A short second side, heat off, onto the plate.

micro-chop-scallion.text: Chop half a scallion into thin rings, two to three millimetres wide. Keep your fingertips curled under.

micro-knife-down.text: Put the knife down flat on the board, with the blade facing away from you.

micro-add-egg.text: Crack one egg into the bowl. Crack it on the flat counter, not the bowl rim — fewer shell pieces.

micro-add-water.text: Pour in forty-five millilitres of water. That is three tablespoons.

micro-add-flour.text: Add three level scoops of flour with the fifteen millilitre spoon. Level, not heaped. Nod when all three are in.

micro-spoon-return.text: Put the measuring spoon back on its rest.

micro-add-salt.text: Twist the salt grinder twice over the bowl. Nod when you are done.

micro-add-pepper.text: Optional: twist the pepper grinder twice over the bowl, or skip it. Nod when you are done.

micro-grinders-return.text: Stand both grinders upright together, away from the bowl.

micro-whisk-batter.text: Whisk steadily for about thirty seconds, until there is no dry flour.

inspect-whisk-batter.text: Lift the whisk and look. How is the batter?

micro-add-scallions.text: Tip all the chopped scallion into the batter. Keep using the same whisk — no need to put it down yet.

micro-stir-scallions.text: Stir gently for five to ten seconds, just until the green is spread through.

micro-whisk-return.text: Set the whisk down on a plate or spoon rest.

micro-heat-on.text: Set the pan on the burner and turn it to medium-low. Turn the pan handle inward, away from the counter edge.

micro-preheat.text: Let the pan warm for about forty-five to sixty seconds.

micro-add-oil.text: Add half a teaspoon of oil and tilt the pan to coat.

micro-pour-batter.text: Pour in all of the batter and let it spread into a round. Hot pan — keep the handle turned inward.

micro-clear-area.text: Move the bowl and scraper away from the burner, and clear the space beside the pan.

micro-cook-first.text: Cook undisturbed for about ninety seconds to two minutes, then check the edges.

micro-flip.text: Slide the spatula under and turn the pancake over in one motion. Hot pan — keep the handle turned inward.

micro-cook-second.text: Cook the second side for about forty-five to sixty seconds, then check it.

micro-heat-off-tools.text: Turn the burner off, then rest the spatula away from the hot pan.

micro-plate.text: Tilt the pan and slide the pancake onto the plate. Hold the pan by its handle — it is still hot.
